lines.text: Peter, a fellow elder, tells the elders to be shepherds of God's flock and examples to it.
When the Chief Shepherd appears, the elders will receive the crown of glory, and young men must submit to elders.
Peter says to cast anxiety on God because He cares, and the devil prowls like a roaring bear.
Peter says to resist the devil, and after a little while of suffering God will restore and strengthen them.
Peter wrote through Timothy, and the church in Babylon sends greetings, as does his son Mark.
